caveats: All ten businesses are private, for-profit education/enrichment operations (preschool, tutoring, dance, music, driving). They are treated as businesses rather than the excluded 'school' type (public/K-12 institutions).
Google Maps review counts were frequently not rendered in the panel view; where a count was not visible it is marked 'count not shown in panel' rather than estimated.

Mobile checks used Chrome device emulation at 390 px. Some Wix/GoDaddy pages reported a fixed ~980 px layout width at that viewport, which is consistent with the clipped screenshots but may be partly influenced by emulation.
data_gaps: Little Spring Montessori Academy's website could not be rendered (invalid TLS certificate), so its layout, forms, robots.txt and JSON-LD could not be inspected.
No Google Business Profile could be found for Elevate Learning Academy in North Brunswick; it may exist under a different name or be unlisted.
Graceful Academy of Dance's robots.txt was not re-checked individually (the Wix default seen on sibling sites allows all crawlers).
Dance4Ever's published class schedules and tuition per location were not located, so pricing questions remain unanswered from public sources.
